title: Chapter 6635: Because They’Re Worthy

Chapter 6635: Because They’Re Worthy

Chapter 6635: Because They’re Worthy

“World Seal!” The square seal pushed Calamities back and astounded everyone.

This treasure was second only to Calamitous Edge. Upon its emergence, the spring surged up like a pillar, seemingly raising World Seal.

“What is it doing?” Spectators watched as the water took on a humanoid form.

“Li Xingchen!” Calamities shouted.

Visual phenomena, including devils, devouring jars, paradises, and dragons returning to their lair, appeared among others. Epochs cycled one after another until the most brilliant of them all. Within were supreme figures and a towering cactus.

These visual phenomena summoned an incredible power to Staff Ancestor and Calamities’ astonishment. The spring and its boundless fortunes resembled the blessing of an immortal or the high heaven.

Others nearby enjoyed its empowerment and had their own visual phenomena. They became vigorous and brimming with power despite the overlords’ suppression.

“Boom!” Only Calamities and Staff Ancestor suffered the weight of the phenomena.

“Go!” Calamities released more tribulations of various affinities - defensive, darkness, godly...

They illuminated the area and formed an ocean to everyone’s astonishment. However, World Seal managed to force them back.

They couldn’t accept defeat and rushed forward again, only for the same thing to happen again. World Seal even smashed them back into Calamities’ body.

“Crackles!” Although he was still engulfed in bolts and flames, people could finally see a youthful silhouette.

This was new to the crowd. Most thought he was the embodiment of tribulations and was formless.

Staff Ancestor’s grand momentum shrank from the pressure as well. Furthermore, her tribulation took advantage of this, wanting to drill into her. Attacks from both sides became effective.

“What is going on?” Spectators wondered why they were blessed instead of suppressed by World Seal.

“Infinity Staff!” Staff Ancestor’s domain expanded dramatically and affected Heaven World.

Everyone thought she wanted to go all-out for a final fight; her domain pushing back against World Seal and the tribulation. Alas, she shocked them by disappearing from the battlefield in the next moment.

As for Calamities, he was clearly stronger than her and continued to fight against World Seal.

“Why is it only targeting supreme overlords?” Light God wondered.

“Because they are worthy of being replicated.” Someone spoke next to him.

He turned back and became startled.

“Brother Sixth-sense.” He maintained a defensive pose right away.

“The timing is good, Brother.” Sixth-sense said before observing the fight.

“What timing?” He felt his hair standing on end upon hearing this.

Li Qiye had warned him that Sixth-sense was a replacement avatar for an immortal from the redemption ground. Of course, he was also created by Bao Pu.
